  "evidence_ids": ["E1.1"],
  "reasons": [
    "According to NCERT Macroeconomics, revenue receipts are receipts that do not lead to a claim on the government and are non-redeemable.",
    "Taxes (including corporation tax) do not create a liability or claim on the government and never have to be returned.",
    "Loans, foreign borrowings, and redeemable securities all lead to repayment claims, making them capital receipts rather than revenue receipts."
  ],
  "syllabus_chapter": "Government Budget & the Economy",
  "syllabus_topic": "Classification of receipts - revenue receipts and capital receipts",
  "syllabus_entitlement": true,
  "presentation_ready": true,

  "principle_applicability": "excerpt_required",
  "decisive_principle_in_excerpts": true,
  "answer_conditions": [
    {
      "condition": "Corporation tax is a non-redeemable tax receipt that creates no future liability or claim against the government.",
      "status": "explicit",
      "alters_key_if_changed": true,
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    }
  ],
  "option_challenges": [
    {
      "option": "B",
      "strongest_reading": "Loans raised by issuing bonds must be repaid on maturity, thereby creating a claim on the government.",
      "correct_under_reading": false,
      "reading_status": "contradicts_stem",
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    },
    {
      "option": "C",
      "strongest_reading": "External borrowing creates a contractual repayment liability with interest, creating a clear debt claim against the government.",
      "correct_under_reading": false,
      "reading_status": "contradicts_stem",
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    },
    {
      "option": "D",
      "strongest_reading": "Securities that are redeemable after a fixed period violate the non-redeemable criterion of revenue receipts.",
      "correct_under_reading": false,
      "reading_status": "contradicts_stem",

    }
  ],

      "evidence_id": "E1.1",
      "premise_quote": "Revenue receipts are those receipts that do not lead to a claim on the government.",
      "reason": "Taxes do not create claims on the government and are revenue receipts."
    },
    {
      "option": "B",
      "status": "contradicted",

      "premise_source": "excerpt",
      "evidence_id": "E1.1",
      "premise_quote": "They are therefore termed non-redeemable.",

    },
    {
      "option": "C",
      "status": "contradicted",
      "false_part": "to be repaid with interest",
      "premise_source": "excerpt",
      "evidence_id": "E1.1",
      "premise_quote": "Revenue receipts are those receipts that do not lead to a claim on the government.",
